fit_population: all official Classification Train rows cycle 47..cutoff, including missing streams, as in the frozen sparse expert
fit_protocol: one sparse LightGBM predictor per cutoff; no validation labels, early stopping, threshold search, or extra fit
model: original sparse LightGBM classifier with exactly three ordered category target-rate logit columns appended to expanded structured + TF-IDF design

prediction_policy.baseline: frozen sparse25 route: .75 C2_B + .25 old sparse binary on present; frozen CB on missing
prediction_policy.present_stream: .75 frozen C2_B probability + .25 new C08 sparse expert probability

queue_recipe.change: For each org/module/pattern append earlier-cycle-only smoothed binary rate, support>=30/smoothing30, first-cycle prior0.5. Store finite clipped logit(rate). Entire cycle encoded before labels update; outer uses all fit labels.
queue_recipe.name: Ordered category outcome rates

scoring_population: STANDARD cutoffs 55/67; rows joined by Train position and record_id
structured: RegressionTextModel expanded structured fit-only preprocessing; no target or ID inputs

target_rate.cycle_rule: encode every row of a cycle before updating category counts/sums with any labels from that cycle
target_rate.missing_category_normalization: C07 convention: pd.isna maps to None; otherwise str(value).strip(); blank strings remain categories
target_rate.outer_scoring: all labels through cutoff are eligible for score rows after cutoff; no score-cycle labels are used
target_rate.prior_policy: fixed 0.5; used in the first cycle and for every category with fewer than 30 earlier-cycle rows, missing categories, or unseen categories

text.missing_stream: empty document plus explicit binary missing indicator
